steps.clickAt: (() => { const e=[...document.querySelectorAll('button,[role=tab]')].find(b=>/^版本/.test(b.innerText.trim()) && b.getBoundingClientRect().x>innerWidth*0.7 && b.getBoundingClientRect().y<120); const r=e?.getBoundingClientRect(); return r?[r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2]:[null,null]; })()

steps.js: const c=document.querySelector('.v3e-ver .v3e-chain'); const v=document.querySelector('.v3e-ver'); if(!c) return {chain:false, verExists:!!v, tabs:[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=tab][aria-selected=true], .on')].map(e=>e.innerText.trim().slice(0,8)).slice(0,5)}; const s=getComputedStyle(c); return {chainMaxH:s.maxHeight, chainOv:s.overflowY, chainH:Math.round(c.getBoundingClientRect().height), verOv:v?getComputedStyle(v).overflowY:null}
